concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-payouts-payout-service-getting-paid-payout-webhooks]] — 2023-modified, 2026-09-15-captured Payout Service Transfer-webhook guide for source-account debit versus bank tracking, instant credit, failure/return and blocked-instrument limits; distinct from legacy Payout API and Marketplace/Platforms routes.
warnings: Payout Service Transfer webhooks are not the legacy Payout API webhook model; booked debits and ETA/tracing are not beneficiary-bank receipt.
Failed internal-review sample retains top-level booked/approved and has 1000 amount versus -10000 received mutation; use nested tracking outcome and do not derive a universal reversal or amount rule.
Permanent-reason blocked transfer instruments cause HTTP 422 on new requests, despite the return-code table's generic retry phrasing for closed/blocked bank accounts.
